limits: No independent tests, HTTP request, source edit, database read or candidate execution by reviewer.
Probe observes source-attested API/ledger reports; it does not repeat independent ledger verification or establish predictive/trading accuracy.
Request timing limits are synchronous socket acceptance bounds, not universal OS cancellation guarantees.

owner_tests.scope: 12 unchanged transport cases plus20 new V2 projection/scheduling cases

review_scope: Preserves existing bounded local-only Reader, decoding, raw-byte retention, actual clocks and77 endpoint+2HTML request cadence; no broker/runtime writes.
V2 schema and exact current source/config pins are checked; report, summary and consumer provenance remains independently retained.
Scheduling projection checks bounded two-attempt identity, first-pass order, chronology, deadline caps, transparent clock traces and transient classification before counting recovery.

First failures are retained separately from final outcomes; recovered empty ledgers are distinct from recovered forecasts; unique original report hashes prevent repeated cache responses inflating denominators.
Public output retains bounded reasons/counts/clocks; complete responses remain private.
Later V2 observation window is explicitly uncontrolled versus V1; two already-open refreshed browser tabs can add concurrent polling load.
